primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB固定版の使徒4:36で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

WEB固定版の使徒11:19で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
WEB固定版の使徒11:20で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
WEB固定版の使徒13:4で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
WEB固定版の使徒15:39で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
WEB固定版の使徒21:3で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
WEB固定版の使徒21:16で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
WEB固定版の使徒27:4で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

review.identityCheckJa: place:cyprus_316 は「Cyprus」の場所用例。割当済みのActs出現を本文ごとに確認し、relatedは出身地・行政地域・地名からの関係として限定。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 紹介文とhistoricalRoleJaは初出の使徒4:36に限定。後続の関連用例は箇所リストに留め、追加情報は記述していない。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 本文見出しは「キプロス島」、冒頭で東地中海の島と説明し、島内に英国・キプロス共和国・北キプロスの領域があるとする（本文冒頭、地理節）。ActsのCyprusは島として扱うため一致。
